name: Monito
description: See network requests, user interaction events, navigation, and console logs. Easily export all the logs in a single archive.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*; connect-src 'self' ws://localhost:* ws://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* https://monito.dev https://*.monito.dev; object-src 'self'
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; child-src 'self';

_execute_action.description: Open Monito for the current tab
